incidents.name: Ncufi self-referred STAKE commission farming
incidents.notes: Ncufi.register() lets a caller name a referrer it also controls and STAKE() pays the referral commission out of the pool immediately, so 100 self-referred 10,000-BUSD stakes returned far more than they cost.
